t: This is St Matthew Street, a street in Westminster, in the SW1 postal district. It takes its name from Matthew the Apostle, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. According to many Christian traditions, he was also one of the four Evangelists, the author of the Gospel of Matthew. That gospel contains the complete Sermon on the Mount and the Beatitudes. There's not much more to say about the street itself, but the name points back to one of the best-known figures in the Christian story.
